svg.text: Mating features (mm unless stated)
feature
value
tolerance
check
Wheel axis
5/8 in (15.9 mm) shaft along x at y -160, z 140; bearing
bores 16.1, wheel and crank disc bores 15.9 (pressed and
glued)
rule from the bench top and the housing's front edge
Lock hole at 12 o'clock
13 mm hole in the side wall at y -160, z 225 (85 mm above
the axis)
with the knob at 12 o'clock the pin enters without touching;
2 degrees either side it hits the wall
Handle pin and travel
8 mm pin on an 85 mm radius; slides 10 mm in its 8.4 mm
bore; tip 4 mm off the wall when out, 2 mm into the hole
when pushed 6 mm
rule on the knob's travel; the wheel is locked once the knob
is 6 mm in
Crank
10 mm pin at 29.5 mm radius (59 mm stroke); the yoke slot is
11 mm high (0.5 mm play a side)
one turn of the wheel moves the head 59 mm (rule on the
carriage)
Specimen head guide
two 8 x 200 mm rods at x 489 and 571, y -34, from z 53 to
253, held by the rod feet (z 94.5-107.5) and the rod bridge
(z 240-253); ear bores 8.3 mm
the head slides its full stroke without binding when the
yoke is lifted off the pin
Head start position
the handle at 10 o'clock puts the head 14.75 mm below its
top
+-1 mm
rule from bench top to cassette centre: 175.25 mm at start,
The prior 160.3/175 figures subtracted the 14.75 mm crank
drop twice.
Cassette clamp
standard cassette 40.4 x 28.4 x 6.5 mm (bought, or printed
from stl/cassette_printed.stl within +-0.3 mm, 6.5 +-0.2 mm
thick) against the clamp face; the rocker's lip holds its
top edge. Cut a 31 x 36 x 8.5 mm slot (x 514.5-545.5, y
4-40, z 189.5-198) through the clamp block for the rocker,
trim the rocker's side arm to 11 mm (x 504-515), and pivot
it on an M4 shoulder screw (5 mm shoulder, 12 mm long) along
x at y 10, z 201.5, threaded into the block
with the lever released the cassette does not fall out as
the wheel runs the head through its stroke
Clamp lever
lever on the clamp's side nearer the robot: an arm 40 mm
forward from the rocker and a 24 mm wide push bar (x
446-470, y 47-55) down to 100 mm above the bench, pushed +y;
rocker turns -1 to 26 degrees
pushing the foot forward opens the lip about 10 mm at 15
degrees. Travel remains available through the model stop at
0.45 rad (25.78 degrees); the spring is not a travel stop.
Knife edge
mock blade edge up at y 53.3, z 130, 80 mm long, 0.5 mm in
front of the block face
feeler gauge between block face and edge
Knife guard
46 mm guard whose knuckle turns on two M4 shoulder screws,
one through each post (5.2 mm bores) into the knuckle's
tapped ends, on the axis y 97, z 142; it rests forward at 0
degrees on a 3 mm ledge filed on each post and stops over
the edge at 190 degrees against the posts' rear faces
+-3 degrees
protractor on the hinge line at each stop
Tray
grey tray 148 x 108 x 22 mm outside, 0.15 kg, loose, centre
at x 290, y 85
taped outline on the bench
Clamp spring mount
LC 030D 12 S: OD 7.62, ID 6.10, free 38.10, solid 10.52 mm.
Spring axis x 466, y 49. Rocker pivot y 10, z 201.45 at
start; rocker top at z 203.45. Follower seat z 207.45 at
rest; bridge underside z 243.10. Installed spring length
35.65 mm, preload compression 2.45 mm. A separate 80 x 5 mm
smooth guide rod passes through 5.2 mm bridge bore; spring
around rod. Polish rod/bore, wax tip.
seat spacing +-0.2 mm after shimming; guide bore 5.2-5.3 mm
measure 35.65 mm seat spacing at rest. At 15 degrees spring
length about25.1 mm; at25.78 degrees about16.6 mm, always
over10.52 mm solid height. Pull follower without spring:
guide drag below0.1 N. Force acceptance3.5-5.5 N at foot
at15 degrees; shim upper spring seat only within documented
preload range2.1-3.1 mm, then recheck travel.
